a4_vlm_evidence: All views consistently show a tall narrow pedestal on a weighted rectangular base, giving the requested long vertical proportion.
The top fan head is small relative to the full pedestal height and contains visible blades within a circular guard.
Side views 2 and 6 reveal an unusually bulky, elongated rear motor housing and a sparse guard profile, reducing manufactured plausibility.
Oblique rear views 3 and 5 expose blocky side-bracket and tilt-joint geometry that appears crowded and partly intersecting around the motor housing.
Despite those awkward junctions, the base, column, guarded rotor, rear housing, and tilt assembly retain consistent positions and proportions across all eight views.
